author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Manchester Airports Group (MAG) data allegedly leaked by FulcrumSec exposes emails and phone numbers of 8.8 million people. title: Crooks Behind Manchester Airports Group Hack Leaked Data of 8.8 Million People

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: PostGREShell (CVE-2026-6471) is a 12-year-old PostgreSQL flaw that lets low-privileged attackers execute code and take over servers. Cyera researchers found a severe PostgreSQL vulnerability, dubbed PostGREShell and tracked as CVE-2026-6471 (CVSS score of 7.2). title: PostgreSQL Hit by 12-Year-Old Vulnerability Allowing Server Takeover

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Hunt.io uncovered a Chinese-speaking campaign using AI agents to automate cyberattacks against Asian government, education and industrial targets. title: Chinese Hackers Use AI Agents in Multi-Country Cyber Campaign

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Google patched 12 Chrome flaws, including an actively exploited V8 zero-day that could enable remote code execution through a crafted webpage. title: Google fixes the sixth actively exploited Chrome zero-day of 2026
